Casting Call (Short Film Paid)
Title: ELEKTRIK KATZENJAMMER

Genre: Psychological Thriller

Logline: The humdrum life of a corporate lackey is transformed when he discovers a mysterious cassette tape that brings him uncanny good fortune. However, in following the cryptic instructions the tape delivers, he finds that his newfound lucky breaks have made him the target of something far more sinister… 

Roles:

THE BOSS (Lead) Male, 40-50s, any race

Description: Years of self-preservation in a soulless capitalist bureaucracy have rendered The Boss greedy, insensate, and casually chauvinistic. However, beneath his vulgarity is a keen intellect that is always scanning for leverage and assessing the quickest route to an advantage. He is not outright evil, but his morality is flexible, especially when there is something to be gained, and he has climbed the corporate ladder through a combination of predatory instincts, oily charm, and an uncanny ability to recognize which way the wind is blowing.

LINDA (Supporting) Female, 40s, any race

Description: An ornery corporate matron. Her years of service have made her so indispensable to the company that firing her would constitute an act of administrative suicide. She has no particular ambitions to climb the corporate ladder, as she has already fashioned her little corner of the bureaucracy into a personal fiefdom. She is always prepared to die on the hill of whatever task is in front of her. Blunt, snippy, and occasionally inappropriate, she is in many ways a kindred spirit to the Boss, albeit one with less interest in upward mobility and more interest in making sure everyone else does their damn job.

LUCAS (Supporting) Male, 20s, any race

The yuppie naïf is the only one around the office who has not yet had his spirit crushed by the unending corporate drudgery. Painfully earnest and open-hearted, Lucas believes that enthusiasm is contagious, people mean well, and things always work out eventually. Although his eagerness is frequently mistaken for self-absorption, the truth is that Lucas simply has a lot to say, and he desperately wants someone to be interested. He’s a dewy-eyed idealist who gets excited about Mondays and brings homemade cookies to disciplinary meetings. 

Directed by: Seamus Carroll

Written by: Sam Thompson

Production Company: Rodeo House

Production Type: Indie Film

Compensation: 

The Boss -$250 (~2 days)

Lucas -$250 (~2 days)

Linda -$125 (1 day)

Meals provided 

Union Status: Non-Union

Shooting Dates: Saturday, October 24th and Sunday, October 25th (Subject to change) 

Filming Location: Denver, CO. 

PLEASE SEND:

An email to seamus@rodeohouse.net with

1. Your headshot

2. Links to any monologues/previous work/acting reel

3. Which role/s you are interested in

4. Your availability on Sunday (8/27) for an in person audition in downtown Denver

MY PREVIOUS WORK

THE THREE DOGS (2026)

sharedPost.text:
THREADS OF TRADITION 

From fabric to movement.
From tradition to transformation.
From waste to possibility.

Threads of Tradition is a live dance performance exploring the journey from the excess of fast fashion to the beauty, resilience, and cultural richness of slow fashion.

Through movement, rhythm, and transforming costumes, the performers take audiences on a journey from synthetic excess to handmade, earth-rooted textiles — celebrating craftsmanship, cultural heritage, durability, and climate justice.

✨ Our journey so far:
🇩🇰 Alternative Fashion Week Denmark 2026
🌍 Klimafolket Festival 2026
🎭 The Top Break Episode 2026

We are grateful for every stage, every audience, and every person who has joined us on this journey.

And the journey continues… 🧵🌱

We are now looking forward to bringing Threads of Tradition to upcoming festivals, fashion weeks, cultural events, and sustainability platforms.

📩 Interested in presenting or programming this piece? Get in touch.

Because every stitch carries a story — and every movement can spark change.

#ThreadsOfTradition #DancePerformance #AlternativeFashionWeek #SlowFashion #SustainableFashion ClimateJustice

🎬 𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐃𝐘 𝐓𝐎 𝐋𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐘𝐎𝐔𝐑 𝐍𝐄𝐗𝐓 𝐑𝐎𝐋𝐄, 𝐁𝐔𝐈𝐋𝐃 𝐘𝐎𝐔𝐑 𝐓𝐄𝐀𝐌, 𝐎𝐑 𝐆𝐄𝐓 𝐘𝐎𝐔𝐑 𝐒𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐄𝐍𝐏𝐋𝐀𝐘 𝐎𝐅𝐅 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐏𝐀𝐆𝐄? 🎥 

The next 𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐬 & 𝐅𝐢𝐥𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐍𝐞𝐭𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭 is right around the corner, and it’s shaping up to be an incredible afternoon of connecting, pitching, and opening real doors in performance and film. 
If you’ve been telling yourself, "I really need to meet more actors, directors, producers, and crew"—this is the one room you cannot afford to miss.

✨ 𝐇𝐞𝐫𝐞’𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮’𝐥𝐥 𝐦𝐞𝐞𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐦:
• 🎭 𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐬: Get noticed by local directors and position yourself for upcoming casting calls. 
• 🎬 𝐃𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐬 & 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐞𝐫𝐬: Discover dedicated talent and skilled technical crew to bring your vision to life. 
• 🛠️ 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐰 & 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬: Connect with active filmmakers, expand your network, and land paid gigs. 
One quick conversation could turn into your next film, paid job, or creative partnership. We can't wait to welcome you! 
📍 𝐕𝐞𝐧𝐮𝐞: HOME Mcr, Manchester, M15 4FN 
🗓️ 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐞: Sunday, 25th October 2026 
⏰ 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞:  2:00 PM – 6:30 PM 

🎟️ 𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐛 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐭𝐬 𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞: [https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/actors-and-filmmakers-networking-event-tickets-1992930150729](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/actors-and-filmmakers-networking-event-tickets-1992930150729)

Mark the date in your diary, and let's make some great connections!

Jeg fulgte opskriften trin for trin, og nu har jeg en mand, der ikke vil spise andet end denne lækkerbisken! Det samme gælder min teenagedreng. Prøv opskriften, og fortæl mig, hvordan resultatet bliver.

**🌟 RECHERCHE DE VRAIES PRATIQUANTES - PAS DE COMÉDIENNES 🌟**

Hello ! 👋🏽
Petite annonce un peu différente des castings habituels 😊

J’aide mon compagnon sur un chouette projet pour une grande marque de sport française. On cherche des **femmes qui pratiquent réellement du sport chez elles** 🧘🏾‍♀️

👉 **Ici, pas de rôle à jouer ni de texte à apprendre : on cherche de vrais témoignages et de vraies habitudes de pratique.**
Yoga, Pilates, renfo/muscu, stretching… si tu pratiques chez toi, ça nous intéresse !

On cherche des femmes :
**👩🏻‍🦰 de 25 à 60 ans**
**👶🏽 avec ou sans enfants**
**🤰 enceintes ou jeunes mamans bienvenues**
**🌸 à différentes étapes de leur vie**
📍 habitant **Paris ou l’Île-de-France**

Pas besoin d’être une grande sportive ni de savoir faire le grand écart 😅 Au contraire, on recherche des profils et des niveaux différents.

**🎤 L’idée :** un entretien pour échanger autour de ta pratique et de tes habitudes.
**💰 En échange : 100 €** pour te remercier de ta participation *(pour un nouveau tapis de sport… ou te faire plaisir, tout simplement 😉).*

Ça te ressemble ou tu penses à une copine ? Envoie-moi un petit MP, merciii ! 💌

/Natalie

Szukamy osoby w wieku 40+ (lub wyglądającej na ten wiek), która wcieli się w rolę nauczyciela. W krótkich filmach (30s) będzie w przystępny sposób tłumaczyć innym zagadnienia.

🎥Na czym polega współpraca?

•Nagrywamy krótkie scenki publikowane na Instagramie i Facebooku
•Nie musisz uczyć się kwestii na pamięć
•Nagrania minimum raz na 2 tygodnie, w terminie ustalanym wspólnie
•Jedno spotkanie trwa ok. 3 h (przygotowanie + ok. 2 h nagrań)
•Studio w Katowicach lub Zabrzu
•100 zł za każdą godzinę spędzoną z nami, czyli za 3-godzinne spotkanie otrzymujesz 300 zł

💼Jak wygląda start?

Zaczynamy od dwóch płatnych próbnych spotkań. Jeśli współpraca będzie się dobrze układać, proponujemy stałą współpracę na rok. Formę umowy ustalimy indywidualnie.

✔️ Kogo szukamy?
Kobiety lub mężczyzny 40+
Osoby naturalnej i swobodnej przed kamerą z pozytywną energią
Doświadczenie aktorskie - niewymagane

📌Jak się zgłosić?
Wyślij na maila Oliwia.manager@gmail.com

•Krótki filmik, w którym opowiesz kilka słów o sobie
•Swój numer telefonu

*Nie musisz się specjalnie przygotowywać. Po prostu weź telefon do ręki i nagraj kilka słów o sobie.

⏳ Zależy nam na czasie, więc wyślij zgłoszenie jak najszybciej! Z wybranymi osobami skontaktujemy się telefonicznie.

One performer. No script. Nothing to hide behind.

On Saturday, 3 October, Inbal Lori steps onto the stage alone.

From that moment on, everything is created live.

Every character. Every relationship. Every twist in the story. Every unexpected moment that makes the room laugh, go quiet, or suddenly feel something nobody planned.

The audience gives the spark. Inbal builds the world.

For one night in Warsaw, you get to watch an extraordinary improviser create an entire performance from nothing, right in front of you. And when the night is over, it disappears.

That exact show will never exist again.

If you love improv, you already know how special that can be. If you have never seen solo improv before, this is a beautiful place to start.

Saturday, 3 October 2026
Doors: 19:30
Show: 20:00

Warsaw A&O Wola

Seats are limited.

Organized by Impact Warsaw
impactwarsaw.com
@impactwarsaw

LIVE PRESENTERS WANTED – START ASAP 🎥

Swiss Peak is a health & wellness brand based in Huyton, Liverpool, and we’re looking for two confident, energetic Live Presenters to join our team.

You’ll be hosting our live shopping sessions, showcasing our products, chatting with viewers and creating an exciting, engaging atmosphere that keeps people watching and buying.

THE ROLE
We currently have two presenter slots available:
Morning Presenter – 4 hours per day
Afternoon Presenter – 4 hours per day
Monday–Friday | Based in Huyton, Liverpool
We’re ideally looking for presenters who can commit to a regular weekday slot and become a familiar face of Swiss Peak.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
We want someone who is:

Bubbly, confident and naturally engaging
Comfortable speaking and selling on camera
Genuinely interested in health, wellness and supplements
Able to maintain energy and enthusiasm throughout a 4-hour live
Good at pacing themselves and keeping conversation flowing
Able to get viewers excited about products, offers and promotions
Reliable and comfortable working to a regular schedule

Energy is particularly important during major sales periods such as Black Friday and the lead-up to Christmas, when our live sessions can get especially busy.

Previous live presenting, sales, TikTok Shop, retail, hosting or content creation experience would be a big advantage, but personality and confidence are just as important to us.

PAY
£15–£20 per hour, depending on previous experience.

START DATE
ASAP
If you’re confident on camera, love speaking to people and think you could bring great energy to Swiss Peak Lives, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply with a little information about yourself, your availability and any relevant presenting, sales or content experience.

Paid Casting Call!
👩‍⚕️ Female healthcare professional: we’re looking for a female actor aged 20-50 

(Also needed for voice over narration)  

Would also need to provide your own smart outfit. 

💁‍♀️ Female Patient: we’re looking for a second female actor aged 20-40 (plus sized) 

💁‍♂️ Male Patient: And one male actor aged 20-40. 

🎥 One day shoot £100 per actor (plus £50 per actor to cover travel expenses and lunch) 

⏰ When: Saturday the 3rd of October 10:00am till 6:00pm. 

📍Where: Boulevard Pharmacy Halifax Yorkshire 

👋 Hi, Frankie here from OtterLight Productions. We’re filming an ad campaign for Boulevard pharmacy in Halifax. There is no dialogue in the shoot as we are filming  B-roll of our actors entering the pharmacy and talking to a healthcare specialist. However, our actor playing the healthcare professional will also be recording voice over for the project. Actors can use shots from the project on their showreel. The ads for the pharmacy will promote consultation services covering vitamin b12 levels, travel vaccines, weight management services, Erectile Dysfunction and period delay.

📧📱Please email your headshot, showreels (if available) and any relevant experience to info@otterlightproductions.co.uk or message Frankie on WhatsApp on 07533585653

Hey ihr Lieben!

Ich suche nach einem/einer Tonmeister*in für meinen Kurzfilm „Ich warte, dass du (AT)“ 

Der Film erzählt einen Beziehungskonflikt in einzelnen Plansequenzen und beschäftigt sich mit dem Spannungsfeld zwischen Geben und Nehmen. Im Zentrum steht die Frage, wie aus zwei Wahrheiten ein Gemeinsam entstehen kann.

Mit diesem Film möchte ich einen intimen Einblick in den Konflikt eines Paares geben, das über den Abend hinweg immer wieder neu Nähe und Distanz aushandelt.

Dreh: 6.-8. November

Ort: Berlin

Gage: unbezahlt - als kleines Dankeschön lade ich das Team im Anschluss des Aufbau-/Blocking Tags ins Restaurant ein. 

Bewerbungen gerne an: notovaa@gmail.com

Liebe Grüße

Anna

First day of 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗹𝗲 𝟮: 𝗩𝗮𝗴𝘂𝘀 & 𝗙𝗼𝗼𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗴𝗲 — and we begin with the face!
​
This is definitely one of our most relaxing modules. We work with the face, hands, and feet, focusing on deep relaxation while also exploring the role of the nervous system — not only for the client, but for the massage therapist too.
​
The pace becomes slower, and the attention to the client’s responses much finer.
​

🎬 CASTING CALL | BERLIN

We are looking for **two actors** for our student short film **PUTZFRAU**, produced as part of our **Beta Project at FilmArche**.

📍 Berlin
🎥 Shooting: **27–29 November 2026**
💰 Unpaid student production

**MALE LEAD | 35–40**

We are looking for someone who presents as **Greek, Spanish, Italian or Southeastern European**, with **dark hair and a medium build**.

The role includes a scene involving physical confrontation, which will be choreographed. Acting experience is welcome but not required.

**FEMALE ROLE | 40–50**

We are looking for a **German woman**, playing age 40–50.
The role has **very little dialogue**.

**ABOUT THE FILM**

After a backbreaking day at work, an immigrant cleaner’s simmering rage overflows when he encounters a wounded German protester who becomes the target of his fury.

The film explores how financial hardship, systemic marginalization and social exclusion can contribute to anger and radicalization.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Please send:

📸 A recent photo
🎭 A short introduction
📅 Your availability for **27–29 November**

📩 **[zelihacenkci@outlook.com](mailto:zelihacenkci@outlook.com)**** OR Facebook DM! **

Previous acting experience is not required.

If you know someone who might be a good fit, please feel free to **share this post or tag them**. Thank you! 🖤

Subject: African Acrobat Group Based in Europe - Available for 2026 Season

Hello, We are available for Christmas contract. 

We are a professional African Acrobats group currently based in Europe.

We offer dynamic 5-30 minute shows blending traditional African acrobatics, dance, human pyramids, and high-energy tumbling.

Ideal for festivals, corporate functions, cultural events and private bookings.

Highlights:
- 5+ years performing across Europe
- Flexible group size (3-8 artists)
- Full insurance & own costumes/music
- Competitive EU rates, no visa/flight costs needed

Showreel & tech rider available on request.

Looking forward to working with you.

Best regards,
Benson chilumo

items.title: Dont make the mistake thinking I'm the same person you once met💪🙏

items.text: It doesn’t take much to get a thespian to board the crazy train! Don’t you love thespian conventions?

sharedPost.text:
Apparently all it takes is one “ALL ABOARD!” and a complete lack of adult supervision. 😂🚂

Day 2 of Theatre Fest and the theatre people are doing what theatre people do best: committing WAY too hard to the bit.

Workshops attended. Vendor swag acquired. Boa deployed. Sanity questionable.

10/10. Would board this train again. 🎭💚
Tx. Educational Theatre Assn.

items.text:
Hi everyone!! 🎬 CASTING CALL OPEN!! 🎬

For our Film & Tv Production Course, we are a making a Neo Noir Crime Thriller short film and we are looking for actors!! 

Project Title: Blood on Blue Notes
Project Type: Student Short Film (Under 15mins)
Filming Location: Birmingham, England (+15 mile radius) (Exact locations TBD)
Shooting Dates: November (Exact dates TBD)
Casting Deadline: October 18th (may be extended if roles aren’t filled)
Compensation: Unpaid (unfortunately), but the finished project will be given to you for Showreel/Portfolio material.

Story Summary
A jazz singer turned vigilante, delivering justice one bloodied note at a time.

Character Descriptions

Miss Josephine Rainey
Role: Lead
Age Range: 20-29
Appearance: Black Actor, Entrancing Eyes, glamorous old Hollywood look, star quality
Language: English
Mature Themes: Will be killing on-screen and have on-screen suggestive intimate actions
Other: Singing is required. Strong jazz/blues vocal skills preferred.

Little Miss Birdie
Role: Supporting
Age Range: 20-29
Appearance: Any Race, ‘Betty Boop’ look, petite, younger appearance, contagious smile
Language: English
Mature Themes: On-screen suggestive actions, such as tease/ innuendos
Other: Dancing is preferred (tap, Charleston, foxtrot, jive etc). Possibly Singing required. 

Mama Selma
Role: Supporting
Age Range: 30-50
Appearance: Black Actor, Mature, Full Figure, Glamorous Soulful Look
Language: English 
Mature Themes: There may be on-screen action shots of protective fight/actions, Smoking on-screen (can be made fake if not a smoker) 
Other: N/A

Bit Parts & Extras:
Comedic/Flirty Bartender - Male, 25-35, Any Race (preferably Black)
Criminals - Male, 20-30, White
Doorman - Male, 20-30, White
Jazz Band - Authentic jazz players preferred, All Ages, All Races
Bar Patrons - All Ages, All Races

*all actors including bit parts and extras must wear 1920s costume!!

If you are interested and think you fit the role requirements please send an email to ebony.tearbanner@gmail.com with the following:
• Name
• Age
• Location
• Which role(s) you are interested in
• OPTIONAL Headshots
• OPTIONAL Showreel
• OPTIONAL Acting Resume

You will then be sent your audition scripts for the self tapes, please send your completed self tape back to ebony.tearbanner@gmail.com with any other necessary content.

If you have any issues with email let me know and we can arrange an alternative method.

We can’t wait to see your interpretations!! 🖤

Can I ask for some advice? My daughter (16) was taken on by an agent during a Stagecoach industry event day, 18 months ago. They advised us to join Spotlight,  for which we pay a monthly fee.
The agent has now said they are dropping her, she has never had any work through them.
Do I continue with Spotlight or stop it. She's been at a performing arts school since year 10 and still loves performing,  but don't want to keep paying for it, if you need an agent to get anything from it.

topComments.text:
I would sign her up ￼to Pheonix casting/ Alessi Hartigan and creative casting.  

Spotlight in my opinion is daylight robbery

Your daughter can still be on Spotlight without an agent but job opertunities are very limited. 
But on the flip side if she looks for a new agent she will need a Spotlight link for them to see her pervious experience

**RUNNER NEEDED – SHORT FILM – LONDON**

Looking for a **runner with a full driving licence** to help out on our upcoming short film, **Oh What a Tragedy**.

It’s a small, self-funded comedy short starring **Liam Williams and Lizzie Davidson**, with a great crew attached.

**Dates:** 24–25 October
**Location:** North London
**Role:** Runner / general production support, including some driving
**Fee:** Unpaid – expenses covered

Would suit someone looking to get more on-set experience and build credits. Looking for someone reliable, proactive and comfortable driving in London.

If interested, DM me with a little about yourself, any previous experience and confirmation that you have a full driving licence.

items.text:
Hi everyone!!

My name is Mackenzie, I am 23 from Santa Clarita, CA and for the last 6 years I have been saying I want to break into the film industry.

It started with the Saw franchise, I was so enthralled with the practical effects I just knew I had to do something like that myself!

I know Los Angeles is over saturated and its a fight for even experienced workers to find jobs right now,
But I am extremely determined to get my foot in the film industry door and would accept ANY help or advice. 

I love making things with my hands
I love people 
I am extremely willing to learn and help
I follow directions and love asking questions 
And I am currently in the middle of a career change.

My goal is to one day Make props or help with set design but I understand that comes with time and knowing the right people.

Does anyone have any advice they would be willing to spare? 

Thank you so much in advance!

items.text:
🎬 **CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW**

We’re currently looking for **adult actors aged 18–28** to join the cast of **The Bros Show**, an independent South London comedy series.

We’re currently casting for:

🔥 **POSH BIRDS — 4 ACTORS | 18–28**
We are looking for four confident, charismatic actresses to play the Posh Birds — a group of four girls with strong personalities, plenty of confidence, and their own chemistry.

They’re not afraid to challenge the Bros, get involved in the chaos, or stand their ground.

Each Posh Bird will have her own personality, so we’re looking for people who can bring something individual to the group.

🚔 **OFFICER MALLISON — 1 ACTOR | 18–26**
A comedic police officer character who works alongside Officer Dixon.

We’re looking for someone with good comedic timing who can play both straight/deadpan moments and more chaotic situations.

👩 **AUNTIE 1 — 1 ACTOR | 18–26**
A comedic auntie character with a strong personality and good screen presence.

🎬 **EPISODE 5 BACKGROUND ACTORS — 18–26**
We’re also looking for multiple adult background/supporting actors for Episode 5.

These are on-screen roles and are a chance to become part of the world of The Bros Show.
🎥 SELF-TAPE

For the acting roles, **all we need initially is a self-tape**.

Please send:

• Your name
• Age
• Where you're based
• A recent photo/headshot
• A short introduction
• Your self-tape for the role you're applying for
• Spotlight/showreel link if you have one

**No previous professional acting experience is required** — we're interested in personality, screen presence, comedy and how you fit the character.
📍 PRODUCTION

📍 South London / London
🎬 Independent production
💰 Currently unpaid
🎥 Actors will receive screen credit, with IMDb credit where applicable.

The project is being created as an independent production with the aim of developing **The Bros Show** into a larger series.

If you're interested, **DM me with your application/self-tape** and state which role you're applying for.

🎬 **THE BROS SHOW — STREETS. ENERGY. CHAOS.**

🎩🕵️ Geheimagent für außergewöhnliche Geburtstagsmission gesucht! 🕵️🎩
Für den 9. Geburtstag meines Sohnes suchen wir eine kreative Person mit schauspielerischem Talent, die Lust hat, Teil eines ganz besonderen Agenten-Abenteuers zu werden.

📅 Wann:

Idealerweise am 31.10. (alternativ 01.11./ 07.11 / 08.11)

📍 Wo:

Unterschleißheim bei München

⏱ Dauer:

Ca. 2 Stunden

👦 Teilnehmer:

Etwa 6 bis 10 Kinder im Alter von 9 bis 11 Jahren.

Die Idee:

Zu Beginn der Feier klingelt ein vermeintlicher Geheimagent an der Tür. Er erscheint in passender Agentenkleidung und sollte auf die Kinder möglichst authentisch und glaubwürdig wirken. Die Kinder sollen wirklich das Gefühl haben, dass ein echter Agent ihre Hilfe benötigt.

Er erzählt, dass er einen gefährlichen Täter verfolgt und dringend Unterstützung bei den Ermittlungen braucht. Gemeinsam mit den Kindern geht er auf Spurensuche, sammelt Beweise, untersucht Hinweise und löst Rätsel.

Wir stellen uns dabei Aktivitäten wie beispielsweise Fingerabdruckanalysen, das Entschlüsseln geheimer Botschaften, versteckte Hinweise, geheime Dokumente, Codes, UV-Hinweise, Tatortspuren oder ähnliche Agenten- und Detektivaufgaben vor. Hier würden wir uns auch über eigene kreative Ideen und Erfahrungen freuen.

Der große Plot-Twist:

Im Laufe der Ermittlungen verdichten sich die Hinweise immer mehr. Am Ende führen alle Spuren zu einem Safe oder einem geheimen Versteck. Dort finden die Kinder schließlich ein Foto des Täters und erkennen überrascht, dass es sich um den Geheimagenten handelt, der sie durch die gesamte Mission begleitet hat.

In diesem Moment wird jedoch die Wahrheit aufgedeckt: Die Agentur wusste bereits von seinem Verrat und hat die Kinder bewusst in die Ermittlungen eingebunden, um seine Tarnung zu entlarven. Die Kinder haben erfolgreich den Fall gelöst und den Täter überführt.

Zum Abschluss werden sie offiziell für ihren Einsatz geehrt und als Nachwuchsagenten ausgezeichnet.

Wichtig:

Wir suchen keine klassische Kinderanimation, sondern jemanden, der die Rolle überzeugend spielen kann und Freude an Improvisation und Storytelling hat. Die Kinder sollen für etwa zwei Stunden vollständig in die Geschichte eintauchen können. Ziel ist ein Erlebnis, das sich möglichst wie ein spannender Agentenfilm anfühlt.

Wir haben bereits viele Ideen für Story, Rätsel und Ablauf und würden diese gerne gemeinsam weiterentwickeln.

Die Tätigkeit wird selbstverständlich angemessen vergütet.

Falls du Interesse hast oder jemanden empfehlen kannst, freuen wir uns über eine Nachricht mit ein paar Informationen zu dir sowie gerne Fotos, Referenzen oder kurzen Videos.

Vielen Dank!

Anna

**[PAID CASTING CALL - INDIE HORROR FMV GAME FOR STEAM]**

BIUM Studio is hiring 2 lead roles for an upcoming horror FMV (Full Motion Video) game shooting in North Lincolnshire.

• **Dates**: 26th - 29th October 2026 (4-day shoot, up to 8h/day with breaks)

• **Pay & Perks**: £300 Fixed Stipend + Travel Costs Covered + Accommodation Provided + Full Catering + High-Quality Showreel Footage & IMDb / Steam Credits

• **Environment**: Low-impact, 4-person set (2 crew, 2 actors)

**ROLES AVAILABLE:**

1. **THE VICTIM** (Maya) - Lead Female (Playing Age 20-25)

- Physical Specs: Height 5'8" and below preferred; slim/athletic build.

- Character: A smart, guilt-ridden former dark-web operative trying to expose her employers from inside her home. Physical movement required (running, crawling, sudden panic/fear reactions). Moderate dialogue with emotional storytelling range (panic, anger, sadness).

2. **THE INVADER** (Marco) - Lead Male (Playing Age 20s-30s)

- Physical Specs: Height 5'10"+ preferred; average to athletic build.

- Character: A calm, methodical, tortured assassin sent to silence Maya. Role involves wearing a full-face mask and performing stealthy, eerie, stalker-like movement. Minimal dialogue; heavy reliance on body language, physical presence, and tension-building movement.

Requires comfort with on-set horror gore and fake blood. Must be 18+ (or 16+ with parental consent).

**APPLY HERE** (includes optional 30-60 sec self-tape prompt): [https://tally.so/r/RGAQNv](https://tally.so/r/RGAQNv)

Poszukujemy 5 Statystów w wieku około 40-60 lat (3 mężczyzn i 2 kobiety) na plan zdjęciowy do spotu dla instytucji kulturalnej w Krakowie (centrum — plener) w dniu 5.10 (poniedziałek) w godzinach 8:30-16:00.

1. Zbiórka punktualnie godz. 7:50
2. Wymagane będzie zabranie kilku kompletów ubrań.
3. Wynagrodzenie: 150 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po planie zdjęciowym — BLIK/Numer konta bankowego).

W razie zainteresowania, dostępności w dniu 5.10, prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację:
1. Imię i nazwisko
2. Rok urodzenia
3. Miasto zamieszkania
4. Telefon kontaktowy
5. Adres e-mail
6. Wzrost
7. Rozmiar ubrania
8. Link do swojego profilu na Facebooku
9. Krótki opis dotychczasowego doświadczenia
110 Minimum 1 zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl
W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Statystowanie Kraków

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w planie zdjęciowym zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

Poznaj nas! Jesteśmy duetem twórczym. Działamy od wielu lat. Z zawodu Jesteśmy aktorami. Postanowiliśmy zbudować własną przestrzeń. W poszanowaniu dla granic. Bez przemocy i presji. Tworzymy własny teatr - profesjonalne spektakle. Prowadzimy też warsztaty artystyczne. Zapraszamy Cię do naszej Akademii Sceny. Spotykamy się w gronie dorosłych i młodzieży. Uczymy profesjonalnego teatru. Tworzymy spektakle. Wymieniamy doświadczenia. Odpoczywamy. Działamy w poczuciu bezpieczeństwa i z dbałością o dobrostan emocjonalny. Dołącz do drużyny Czułego Teatru!

Spotykamy się w środy o 17.30 w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury. 

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się o nas więcej, odwiedź stronę internetową:

https://www.czulafundacja.pl/akademia-sceny

Możesz też do nas napisać na: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

Albo przyjść na zajęcia w najbliższą środę!

Room to Become — Paid Casting Overview
Project type

Commercial / branded short film. ~60-second hero spot with :30, :15, and :06 cutdowns, shot in 16:9 and 9:16 for paid media, social, connected TV, and web.

Project description

A 60-second brand film for a national student housing company, set in a single apartment over the course of a school year, with limited dialogue.

The story follows a college student through the everyday moments of living on their own with roommates. Over the year, an empty apartment becomes a home, and the student grows into a more confident version of themselves.

The tone is grounded, observational, and warm. We want naturalistic performers who can carry a scene with small, true behavior (a pause, a look, a laugh that runs too long) instead of big acting.

Roles

The Student (Lead) — Plays 18–24, any gender or ethnicity. On screen throughout. Grows from a guarded newcomer into the heart of the household over the year. Needs strong stillness and the ability to play a lot without words. Some dialogue.

The Roommate (Supporting) — Plays 18–24, any gender or ethnicity. Starts as a stranger and becomes a close friend. A quiet, steady presence. Light dialogue.

Friends (Featured, 2) — Plays 18–24. Part of the Student's growing circle, appearing across several scenes. Physical comedy and improv a plus.

All performers must be 18 or older. We're especially interested in hearing from local college film and theatre students.

Self-tape instructions

All roles use the same self-tape. Tell us which role(s) you're interested in, and we'll cast from what we see. Keep it natural, and keep the whole tape under a minute. Phones are fine.

Slate (about 10 sec): Your name, city, confirmation that you're 18 or older, and your availability for the shoot date.

Quiet call (10–15 sec): You've had a rough day and you call home, but you don't want them to worry. Play only your side of the call.

"Hey. No, nothing's wrong, I just hadn't talked to you in a couple days. … Yeah. It's good. It's fine. … No. I'm good. Love you too."

Loud call (about 10 sec): Months later, you call the same person with great news from a packed room.

"I did it — I actually did it! … Come over. To my place. Come celebrate."

Send self tapes and any previous content you'd like reviewed to Ryan.Sundling@AgencyFIFTY3.com.

Union status

Non-union.

Compensation

Paid. Flat rate per role, which includes the shoot day and a usage buyout in perpetuity (all media: paid, social, web, and connected TV). Meals provided on set.

The Student: $350

The Roommate: $250

Friends: $200 each

Key dates & locations

Submissions and self-tapes due: October 8

Shoot: TBD, one day between October 13 and 21. The Student and Roommate are needed for the full day (up to 10 hours, including a meal break); the Friends for about three-quarters of the day.

Location: TBD, in the Denver metro area. One apartment interior. Local hire only; no travel or lodging provided.

Hi! We are seeking actors for our student film, "FIREWALL", shooting in Denver

Logline: During a museum tour, a wealthy woman becomes fixated on a million dollar painting that is hung facing the wall. When her attempts to buy it are denied, her obsession with unveiling the mysterious painting grows.

Synopsis: The moment Anais Poklova lays eyes on the canvas, she will stop at nothing to have it. Titled *The Most Beautiful Painting, *and yet, since the artist’s death, nobody alive has seen what’s on the other side of it. Anais makes an offer, but the tour guide, Joseph, informs her that the painting is protected and cannot be bought. Anais can’t accept this. Like fire lighting up dry kindling, her mind becomes consumed by thoughts of the painting, bringing out the worst of her insatiable, deep-seeded need for control. She comes up with a plan, returns to the museum, and boldly offers Joseph a bribe; if he helps her steal the painting, she’ll give him the money he needs to save his family. It goes against everything he believes in, but Joseph and Anais both know that when it comes to family, there isn’t really a choice. Joseph agrees to the heist, and Anais is so close to victory she can taste it. With nothing standing between her and painting, Joseph suddenly realizes that there may be a way to stop Anais *and *keep the money.

This will be an unpaid, reel opportunity tentatively shooting Nov 6-8th with an extra day the weekend of Nov 13th.

Food will be provided and transportation if needed. 

**In-Person auditions will be held on Oct 4th from 2-5 PM at the Central Denver Library in room #242**

**Audition slots can be selected via the link below!**

**Audition reels can be submitted to parranika20@gmail.com!**

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUc6Sqynn5xzrffrVVK8AKNNOpISb1mfBOS4pIUSrARJHOgA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=111879408904497575567](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUc6Sqynn5xzrffrVVK8AKNNOpISb1mfBOS4pIUSrARJHOgA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=111879408904497575567)

**STOP IMAGINING SOUND. START BUILDING YOUR INSTRUMENT.**

*Online Vocal Coaching Based Purely on Vocal Physiology & Physics*

Welcome to the **Vocal Gym**.

Mirella Freni's student

Guildhall School of Music and Drama graduate

Lunenburg Academy of Music Performance Artist in Residence

Most traditional coaching relies on vague visualizations and acoustic myths (*"sing in the mask"*, *"feel the sound between your eyes"*). Your voice is not a metaphor - it is a biological, physical instrument governed by muscle isolation, air pressure, and pharyngeal geometry.

Whether you are an amateur building your voice from scratch or a working professional struggling with vocal fatigue, real progress comes from concrete biomechanics:

* **Targeted Muscle Isolation:** Isolate and balance the TA (*Thyroarytenoid*) and CT (*Cricothyroid*) muscles to build genuine core power, register balance, and flexibility without strain.
* **Pharyngeal Geometry & Real Projection:** Utilize the pharyngeal resonator and *Squillo* for projection that cuts through any mix - without forcing air or spreading into a smile.
* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

🎁 **FREE 1st ONLINE CONSULTATION**

*30-Minute Biomechanical Vocal Audit & Diagnostic Session*

We’ll analyze your current vocal setup, pinpoint physical blockages, and lay out a clear, objective training roadmap.

📍 **Format:** 1-on-1 Online

📩 **How to book:** Send a DM now to claim your free diagnostic session. Space is limited!

CASTING CALL | DORTMUND | No-Budget-Kurzfilm (Thriller/Horror)
Für unseren atmosphärischen Indie-Kurzfilm Haunted Guilt (das Debüt-Projekt von Umbra Refugium Films) suchen wir im Raum Dortmund noch markante Darsteller für zwei prägende Rollen.

⚠️ Wichtiger Hinweis: Es handelt sich hierbei um eine unabhängige No-Budget-Produktion. Wir suchen passionierte Schauspieler, die Lust haben, ein handgemachtes, spannendes Projekt im Ruhrgebiet zum Leben zu erwecken.

Gesuchte Rollen:

WOLFGANG (Spielalter: ca. 50 + Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Markant, geheimnisvoll, getrieben. Wolfgang trägt eine innere Schwere mit sich herum, die ihn undurchschaubar und gefährlich wirken lässt. Er hat eine intensive, zurückhaltende Präsenz, die den Zuschauer ständig an seinen Absichten zweifeln lässt.

Anforderung: Gespielt wird ein Charakter mit Ecken und Kanten, der eine zentrale, bedrohliche Rolle in der Geschichte spielt.

OTTO (Spielalter: ca. 45+  Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Charismatisch, manipulativ, besitzergreifend. Otto ist der Kopf hinter dem Geschehen, ein Puppenspieler mit eiskaltem Verstand. Er verbirgt seine wahre Natur hinter einer freundlichen Fassade, die jedoch schnell Risse bekommt.

Anforderung: Satter schauspielerischer Ausdruck, der die psychologische Spannung und den Horror des Thrillers trägt.

Eckdaten:

Projekt: Haunted Guilt (Kurzfilm / Psychothriller)

Ort: Dortmund & Umgebung

Gagen: Unbezahltes Indie-/No-Budget-Projekt Verpflegung am Set inklusive

Drehzeitraum: 10-18 Oktober

Du hast Lust auf ein ambitioniertes, eigenständiges Projekt mit starkem visuellen Look und möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Schreib uns gerne eine Nachricht mit deinen aktuellen Sedcard-Fotos / Showreel an:

📧 philippbrendel2@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen!

Anbei noch ein kurzer atmosphärischer teaser Trailer!!

CASTING CALL | DORTMUND | No-Budget-Kurzfilm (Thriller/Horror)
Für unseren atmosphärischen Indie-Kurzfilm Haunted Guilt (das Debüt-Projekt von Umbra Refugium Films) suchen wir im Raum Dortmund noch markante Darsteller für zwei prägende Rollen.

⚠️ Wichtiger Hinweis: Es handelt sich hierbei um eine unabhängige No-Budget-Produktion. Wir suchen passionierte Schauspieler, die Lust haben, ein handgemachtes, spannendes Projekt im Ruhrgebiet zum Leben zu erwecken.

Gesuchte Rollen:

WOLFGANG (Spielalter: ca. 50 + Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Markant, geheimnisvoll, getrieben. Wolfgang trägt eine innere Schwere mit sich herum, die ihn undurchschaubar und gefährlich wirken lässt. Er hat eine intensive, zurückhaltende Präsenz, die den Zuschauer ständig an seinen Absichten zweifeln lässt.

Anforderung: Gespielt wird ein Charakter mit Ecken und Kanten, der eine zentrale, bedrohliche Rolle in der Geschichte spielt.

OTTO (Spielalter: ca. 45+  Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Charismatisch, manipulativ, besitzergreifend. Otto ist der Kopf hinter dem Geschehen, ein Puppenspieler mit eiskaltem Verstand. Er verbirgt seine wahre Natur hinter einer freundlichen Fassade, die jedoch schnell Risse bekommt.

Anforderung: Satter schauspielerischer Ausdruck, der die psychologische Spannung und den Horror des Thrillers trägt.

Eckdaten:

Projekt: Haunted Guilt (Kurzfilm / Psychothriller)

Ort: Dortmund & Umgebung

Gagen: Unbezahltes Indie-/No-Budget-Projekt Verpflegung am Set inklusive

Drehzeitraum: 10-18 Oktober

Du hast Lust auf ein ambitioniertes, eigenständiges Projekt mit starkem visuellen Look und möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Schreib uns gerne eine Nachricht mit deinen aktuellen Sedcard-Fotos / Showreel an:

📧 philippbrendel2@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen!

Anbei noch ein kurzer atmosphärischer teaser Trailer!!

casting call: non-union / volunteer actor for indie music video

project: music video for a local artist

role: "john" (male, age 40–60+)

shoot location: east vancouver

shoot date: sept 30th or oct 2nd (morning/afternoon — max 2-4 hours)

compensation: volunteer (credit, final video for reel, coffee/snacks)

about the character & scene:

looking for an expressive actor to play john, a weary everyday shopkeeper who hits a sudden moment of pure joy.

the scene: john is sitting at work in his shop checking his lotto ticket next to a framed photo of his daughter. he checks his numbers against the tv, realizes he won, and goes from tired to total ecstatic celebration.

what we’re looking for: solid facial expressions—someone who can sell that shift from heavy exhaustion to genuine, contagious joy. no dialogue needed, just visual acting.

how to apply:

send me a dm with a quick headshot or photo along with your availability for sept 30 and oct 2! 

thanks so much!

🎬 CASTING WARSZAWA — ŚWIĄTECZNA REKLAMA SZYNEK! 🎄
Cześć Warszawo! 😁

Zapraszam na casting do świątecznej reklamy w klimacie kostiumowej komedii romantycznej! 🙂

Szukam charakterystycznych, naturalnych twarzy — aktorów i epizodystów ze świetnym wyczuciem komedii sytuacyjnej.

⭐ ROLE GŁÓWNE:

• „Kobieta” — 20–25 lat, subtelna i naturalna uroda, długie włosy, szczupła sylwetka.

• „Rycerz” — mężczyzna w wieku 25–30 lat, przystojny, proporcjonalnie zbudowany, z dłuższymi włosami.

🎭 ROLE EPIZODYCZNE:

• „Mężczyzna w kolejce” — 50–55 lat.

• „Kobieta w kolejce” — 40–50 lat.

• „Pan z wąsem” — 40–50 lat, wymagany wąs.

• „Szlachcic” — poszukiwani kobieta i mężczyzna w wieku 30–45 lat.

• „Mikołaj” — mężczyzna w wieku 55–60 lat, o pełniejszej, zaokrąglonej twarzy i lekko zaokrąglonej sylwetce, do roli Świętego Mikołaja.

📅 TERMINY:

• 7.10 — recall w studiu.

• 15.10 — przymiarki.

• 20–21.10 — zdjęcia w Warszawie.

Na tym etapie nie wiadomo jeszcze, kto będzie potrzebny na jeden, a kto na dwa dni zdjęciowe. Proszę uwzględnić oba terminy.

💰 STAWKI:

• Dzień zdjęciowy: 1500 zł + 20% prowizji.

• Prawa — role główne: 3500 zł + 20% prowizji.

• Prawa — role epizodyczne: 2000 zł + 20% prowizji.

📺 ZAKRES PRAW:

Okres: 15.11.2026–31.12.2026.

Emisja: telewizja oraz digital, w tym Internet, VOD i social media.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

To proste! 🙂 Wymagana jest rozszerzona wizytówka. Karta castingowa nie jest obowiązkowa.

Zgłoszenia proszę przesyłać na:

plan@filmakcja.pl

W tytule maila proszę wpisać nazwę roli, do której się zgłaszacie.

W mailu proszę zamieścić:

• imię i nazwisko,

• wiek,

• wyraźne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki,

• rozszerzoną wizytówkę.

⏰ Termin zgłoszeń: poniedziałek, 5.10, do godz. 16:00.

Zainteresowanym prześlę link do zgłoszenia.

Czekam na Was! 🎬😁

Marta Filmakcja

HASTER: MANDLIGT ENSEMBLE SØGES TIL “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”! 🎭
Alle herrer/mænd i alderen 18-40 år, der ikke allerede har været til audition på Musicalteatrets kommende opsætning af “Jack the Ripper: The Musical”, er velkomne til at tilmelde sig. Der søges IKKE længere personer til roller med replikker/solosang eller kvindelige castmedlemmer. Der søges KUN 2-4 mænd i alderen 18-40 år, som skal indgå i ensemblet og koret. Der lukkes ned for tilmeldinger, så snart de 2-4 mænd er blevet fundet.

Krav: Du skal kunne synge kor i forestillingen (tenor, baryton eller bas). Korerfaring er ikke et krav, men en fordel. Det er heller ikke et krav at kunne danse, men kun et plus, hvis du har erfaring med at bevæge dig til musik.

Prøveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027 på Frederiksberg.
Spilledatoer/spillested: 3.-20. marts 2027 på Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene (København).
Tilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

‘Tag’ gerne potentielt interesserede bekendte i kommentarsporet, og læs mere om at tilmelde sig sang-audition som mandligt kor/ensemble-medlem på Musicalteatrets hjemmeside her: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Hello Subject: Professional Dancer – Job Application. Dear Sir/Madam, My name is Khayal Sadikhov, and I am a professional dancer from Azerbaijan with over 20 years of international stage experience. Throughout my career, I have performed with Cirque Medrano, Anadolu Ateşi, the Azerbaijan State Folk Dance Ensemble, and other international productions. My specialties include Caucasian dance, classical ballet, modern dance, and acrobatic performance. I would be very interested in joining your team and taking part in your upcoming productions and projects. I believe my extensive stage experience and professional background could be a valuable contribution to your company. Please find my CV an performance videos attached for your consideration. Thank you very much for your time. I would be happy to provide any additional information if required. Best regards, Khayal Sadikhov. Gmail: khayalgenje2020@gmail.com

sharedPost.text:
ATELIERS THÉÂTRE - ADULTES

Quand ?
Tous les samedis matins de 10h à 12h

Où ?
Au TNR, 3-5 rue Péan, 75013 Paris // Métro : Porte d’Ivry (Ligne 7)

Combien ?
180€ par trimestre + 10€ d’adhésion.
Il est possible d’avoir un tarif préférentiel selon votre coefficient familial (égal ou inférieur au QF4).

Le cours d’essai est gratuit !

Inscriptions, contactez Andréa : 06 32 07 69 48 // andrea.fulconis2@gmail.com

DESCRIPTIF

Le cours est ouvert à tous les adultes de 18 à 99 ans, désireux de rencontrer - ou de re-rencontrer - le théâtre.

- L’année sera divisée en deux parties - 

De septembre à décembre, nous travaillerons les outils du comédien par le biais d’exercices et d’improvisations (seul, à plusieurs, ou en collectif). Nous aborderons le corps et la voix de l’acteur, mais aussi son rapport à l’espace, à l’autre, au public, au silence... À travers cette recherche préliminaire, nous souderons le groupe. Le collectif sera notre maître-mot : c’est ensemble que l’on apprendra et que l’on grandira au plateau. L’objectif étant de monter une pièce ensemble durant la deuxième partie de l’année.

De janvier à juin, nous monterons, en effet, un spectacle à partir d’un texte d’auteur. Classique ou contemporain, comique ou tragique, nous trouverons l’auteur qui vous fait envie, la langue que vous voulez porter, l’histoire que vous voulez défendre ! Nous entamerons, alors, un travail précis d’interprétation du texte et de personnages, à travers une mise en scène crée sur mesure pour votre groupe. Un langage commun et une esthétique propre à la création nous rassemblera.

Plusieurs représentations sont prévues à la fin de l’année : nous jouerons notre pièce plusieurs fois devant un public bienveillant !

LA PROF - Andréa Fulconis

En parallèle d’un Master de Littérature Française à La Sorbonne, Andréa se forme aux Conservatoires d’Art Dramatique (CRD de Cannes, CRR de Nice et CRD de Bobigny). Puis, elle intègre l’École Internationale de Théâtre Jacques Lecoq, célèbre école de jeu corporel. Enfin, elle intègre la LUDI (Ligue Universitaire d’improvisation d’Île-de-France) et se perfectionne en improvisation.

Elle travaille, par la suite, pour plusieurs compagnies d’île-de-France en tant que comédienne, improvisatrice et metteuse en scène, comme Tonnerre de Singe, La Mazane ou Les Loups-Graou, qui sont tout autant d’espaces et des foyers de création lui permettant de développer sa recherche artistique.

La pédagogie prend également une place importante dans sa vie puisqu’elle est professeure de théâtre et d’improvisation pour la Cie Maya, la Ludo Impro’, La Mazane, et désormais au TNR, pour la Compagnie Tonnerre de Singe

Riche de toutes ces expériences, Andréa mêle, dans ses cours de théâtre, un travail précis de texte - hérité de sa formation classique - à une recherche vivante et corporelle, telle qu’elle s’en est emparée par la suite dans son travail artistique. Ses cours sont, pour elle, un espace de recherche à part entière, au même titre qu’une création professionnelle.

🎬 Carrelage Audois
Quand tradition, modernité… 

Entre le charme médiéval de Carcassonne et la modernité élégante du showroom CARRELAGE AUDOIS, nous avons imaginé un film où un chevalier un brin rustre se heurte aux ambitions déco de sa dame, dans une aventure pleine d’humour et de contraste.

Et pour donner vie à cette histoire, j’ai pu compter sur ma belle bande d’extraordinaires farfadés mon équipe joyeuse, créative et délicieusement décalée, qui transforme chaque tournage en épopée aussi folle que fabuleuse.

Un projet qui célèbre la créativité, l’ingéniosité et le plaisir de raconter des histoires avec personnalité.

✨ Un film signé Black & White Pictures, où tradition et modernité s’entremêlent avec style, humour… et un farfadisme pleinement assumé.

D / DP : Bryan Plez 
Talent : Stéphane Matthieu / Valérie Arciet
Prod.Général : Yohann Bringuier

topComments.text: I'm literally like so gutted. It's my 50th on Friday 13th November but I would have loved to have done this course. CASTING CALL: INDEPENDENT SHORT FILM bilingual actors and actresses
(animation) ( all languages welcome)

Project Details

• Project Title: Behind the Screen IT CAN HAPPEN AT ANY AGE 

• Project Type: Independent Drama / Awareness Campaign Short Film

• Director: C. Sciamma

• Audition Location: online 

• Shoot Dates: October 27 - December –4, 2026 (Flexible on the dates)

• Location of Shoot: from the comfort of your home/studio ( all equipment is provided)

• Compensation: Paid (Copy, Meals, Footage provided + $300/day stipend)

Roles Available

1. THE TARGET (Lead)

• Age: 18–35 (University Student)

• Gender: Open (Male or Female)

• Description: Grounded, relatable, and studying at a local university. They become the focus of a viral cyberbullying campaign that spills from online forums into real-life campus spaces. This role requires immense emotional depth, vulnerability, and the ability to portray the psychological toll of digital harassment.

2. THE ANTAGONIST (Supporting)

• Age: 18–35 (University Student)

• Gender: Open (Male or Female)

• Description: Charismatic, tech-savvy, and deeply insecure. A fellow student or member of the campus community who instigates the online attacks from behind a keyboard. Looking for an actor who can bring layers to this character, exploring the toxic motivations behind online trolling rather than playing a cartoonish villain.

3. THE CONFIDANTE (Supporting)

• Age: 18–35 (University Student / Peer)

• Gender: Open (Male or Female)

• Description: A loyal friend, classmate, or roommate. They witness the impact of the bullying firsthand and try to help, highlighting the struggle bystanders face when trying to intervene effectively in digital and physical campus spaces.

4. THE PARENT / MENTOR (Supporting)

• Age: 40–60 (Community Member)

• Gender: Open (Male or Female)

• Description: A stabilizing, older presence in the protagonist's life—either a parent or a concerned university lecturer. They are deeply protective but struggle to understand the fast-paced, overwhelming nature of digital harassment. This character bridges the generational gap on how social media impacts mental health.

What We Are Looking For

• Actors capable of handling intense dramatic themes with maturity and nuance.

• Must be be available to finish on deadline 

How to Apply

Please send an email to filmwork2026@protonmail.com with the subject line: CASTING – [Role Name] – [Your Full Name].

Include the following in your submission:

• Resume / CV or a short paragraph detailing your acting experience.

• Reel or Self-Tape link (YouTube, Vimeo, or Google Drive).

• Confirmation that you are available on the shoot dates.

Submission Deadline:  October 10, 2026

Trigger Warning: This project deals heavily with themes of cyberbullying, online harassment, and mental health struggles. The safety and well-being of our cast is paramount, and a supportive, respectful environment will be maintained on set at all times.

🚨 $40-$50/HR NEXT WEEK!!!
Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking dependable, outgoing, and professional Event Managers and Brand Ambassadors for brand launch activations across five markets next week!

Dates, Times & Locations:
📍 Memphis, TN
Mon, Oct 5 → Tues, Oct 6, 2026
11:00 PM–7:00 AM

📍 Raleigh, NC
Mon, Oct 5 → Tues, Oct 6, 2026
10:00 PM–6:00 AM

📍 Cleveland, OH
Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
1:00 AM–7:00 AM

📍 Jacksonville, FL
Weds, Oct 7 → Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
10:00 PM–7:00 AM

📍 Kansas City, MO
Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
8:00 AM–4:00 PM

All times are onsite hours and include setup, activation, and breakdown for both roles.

Compensation:
• Event Managers: $50 per hour
• Brand Ambassadors: $40 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Event Managers will receive additional paid hours for offsite pickups and returns.

Event Details:
Help introduce new products from a national food brand to employees, warehouse teams, and drivers before they reach the market. The activation will feature product sampling, food, refreshments, giveaways, and an onsite raffle.

Event Manager Duties:
• Coordinate logistics, lead the onsite team, and manage event flow.
• Pick up and return event supplies at Southwest Cargo near the airport.
• Collect Walmart orders containing food, refreshments, and event supplies.
• Transport equipment and lead team setup, breakdown, and loading.
• Oversee sampling, food and refreshments, giveaways, and raffle participation.
• Complete a recap report through Google Forms and upload event photos to Google Drive.

Event Manager Requirements:
• Must have a truck, SUV, or van capable of transporting a 10×10 tent, table, backdrop, banner, premiums, and supplies.
• Must be available for pickups and returns before and after the event.
• Must have prior Event Manager experience and strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
• Must lead by example, actively performing Brand Ambassador duties while guiding and supporting the team.

Brand Ambassador Duties:
• Assist with unloading, setup, breakdown, packing, and loading.
• Welcome employees and drivers and introduce products using approved messaging.
• Assist with product sampling, food, refreshments, and giveaways.
• Encourage raffle participation and explain entry instructions.
• Keep the activation clean and organized while supporting smooth guest flow.
• Support the Event Manager and represent the brand professionally.

Staff Expectations:
We are looking for punctual, dependable, and engaging staff who work well as a team. You must be comfortable assisting with setup and breakdown and working the full scheduled shift, including overnight hours where applicable.

Application Process:
To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:
• Market & Role
• Availability
• Resume
• Headshot
• Relevant experience
• A brief description of why you’re an excellent fit for this role
• Event Managers - confirm you have a truck, SUV, or van to transport assets.

Please use “Brand Launch — [City/Role]” as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.

Casting für junge Künstler:

Dinnershow im Krönum

**Du bist ein talentierter Künstler und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einer einzigartigen Dinnershow präsentieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!**

 

Wir suchen junge, kreative Künstler aus den Bereichen Akrobatik, Tanz, Musik, Comedy und mehr, die Lust haben, bei einer exklusiven Dinnershow im Krönum mitzumachen. Du kannst dich auch gerne als Duo bewerben!

 

So kannst du dich bewerben:

 

-   Schick uns ein kurzes Video (max. 3 Minuten) von deinem Auftritt oder einer Performance, die du vor kurzem durchgeführt hast. Zeige uns deine Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft für die Bühne!

-   Wir treffen eine Vorauswahl und laden die ausgewählten Künstler zu einem persönlichen Casting ein, das am 01.10. stattfinden wird. In absoluten Ausnahmefällen ist auch ein anderer Termin auf Anfrage möglich.

 

Warum teilnehmen?

-   Du erhältst die Chance, Teil einer einzigartigen Dinnershow im Krönum zu werden.

-   ﻿Die Shows beginnen im März und enden im Dezember. Gespielt wird an den Wochenenden und in den sächsischen Ferien. Details folgen.

-   ﻿﻿Es warten spannende Auftrittsmöglichkeiten und ein kreatives Team auf dich.

-   Du kannst dich vor einem begeisterten Publikum präsentieren.

 

Bewerbung:

Sende dein Video inkl. Bilder, sowie eine kurze Beschreibung deiner Person bis spätestens 30.09.2026 an [kulti@turisede.de](mailto:kulti@turisede.de).

Infos zum bereits laufenden Krönum: [https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html](https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html)

 

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht bald gemeinsam auf der Bühne im Krönum zu stehen!

Hello, my name is Elliot Harrington and I am the producer of the upcoming short film called “Sponsored By”. It is about a divorced father who takes on coaching a Little League baseball team in hopes to impress his boss, get a promotion, and be invited to an exclusive BBQ.

- Individuals to play businessmen. Must read as 30-50 years of age

Shooting Dates:

- October 4th: 8 AM-6 PM

**STOP IMAGINING SOUND. START BUILDING YOUR INSTRUMENT.**

*Online Vocal Coaching Based Purely on Vocal Physiology & Physics*

Welcome to the **Vocal Gym**.

Mirella Freni's student

Guildhall School of Music and Drama graduate

Lunenburg Academy of Music Performance Artist in Residence

Most traditional coaching relies on vague visualizations and acoustic myths (*"sing in the mask"*, *"feel the sound between your eyes"*). Your voice is not a metaphor - it is a biological, physical instrument governed by muscle isolation, air pressure, and pharyngeal geometry.

Whether you are an amateur building your voice from scratch or a working professional struggling with vocal fatigue, real progress comes from concrete biomechanics:

* **Targeted Muscle Isolation:** Isolate and balance the TA (*Thyroarytenoid*) and CT (*Cricothyroid*) muscles to build genuine core power, register balance, and flexibility without strain.
* **Pharyngeal Geometry & Real Projection:** Utilize the pharyngeal resonator and *Squillo* for projection that cuts through any mix - without forcing air or spreading into a smile.
* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

🎁 **FREE 1st ONLINE CONSULTATION**

*30-Minute Biomechanical Vocal Audit & Diagnostic Session*

We’ll analyze your current vocal setup, pinpoint physical blockages, and lay out a clear, objective training roadmap.

📍 **Format:** 1-on-1 Online

📩 **How to book:** Send a DM now to claim your free diagnostic session. Space is limited!

🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO
Role bez tekstu.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową

Poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Mężczyzna — 20 - 25 lat

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.

Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.

Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny.

Kobieta — 19 - lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.

Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.

Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 70–80 lat

Senior o bardzo charakterystycznej twarzy, siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.

Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.

Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 30–40 lat

Przystojny, charakterystyczny mężczyzna o wyrazistych rysach i ciemnych włosach.

Postać pojawia się w kilku okresach: lata 60,70 i 80, dlatego ważna jest możliwość wiarygodnego pokazania upływu czasu.

Typ: charyzmatyczny, męski, ekranowy.

Kobieta — 30–40 lat

sharedPost.text:
🎬 NOWE CASTINGI. CODZIENNIE. W JEDNYM MIEJSCU.

Jeśli masz dość szukania ogłoszeń po grupach, social mediach i różnych stronach - Easycasting ma wszystko w jednym miejscu.

Na platformie znajdziesz castingi do:
🎥 filmów
📺 seriali
📢 reklam
📸 sesji zdjęciowych
🎤 projektów muzycznych
💃 produkcji dla tancerzy, modeli, aktorów, statystów i twórców

I co ważne - nowe ogłoszenia pojawiają się regularnie, więc zawsze możesz sprawdzić, co aktualnie jest dostępne.

Dlaczego warto mieć profil na Easycasting?

✔️ wszystkie castingi w jednym miejscu  
✔️ dopasowane powiadomienia o ofertach, które mogą pasować właśnie do Ciebie  
✔️ profesjonalny profil, który działa jak Twoje portfolio  
✔️ zdjęcia, doświadczenie i najważniejsze informacje zawsze pod ręką  
✔️ aplikowanie jednym kliknięciem - bez ciągłego przepisywania tych samych danych  
✔️ łatwy dostęp do nowych projektów i szybkie reagowanie na ogłoszenia  

Zamiast za każdym razem pisać wszystko od początku, po prostu uzupełniasz profil raz i możesz korzystać z niego przy kolejnych zgłoszeniach.

A jeśli jeszcze nie korzystasz z Easycasting, możesz zacząć bez ryzyka:

🔥 30 dni całkowicie za darmo - bez żadnych kosztów na start.

Załóż profil, sprawdź najnowsze castingi i zobacz, co jest dostępne dla Ciebie.

👉 www.easycasting.pl

Może właśnie teraz czeka tam projekt, do którego pasujesz idealnie. 🎬

Cześć! Szukam producenta lub producentki zainteresowanych nowym projektem pełnometrażowym.

Ukończyłem scenariusz, nad którym pracowałem przez ostatnie lata. To dramat psychologiczny z elementami thrillera i science fiction. Mam również przygotowane materiały projektowe. Film chcę wyreżyserować jako swój debiut pełnometrażowy.

Chciałbym nawiązać współpracę przy przygotowaniu filmu do realizacji. Jeśli taki projekt mieści się w obszarze Twoich zainteresowań, zapraszam do wiadomości prywatnej. Chętnie opowiem więcej i prześlę materiały.

Cześć Warszawo! 😁

Szukam mężczyzny do pracy jako stand-in na planie 07.10.

🕙 Start planowany jest na godz. 10:00, a praca potrwa około 5–6 godzin. Wymagana jest jednak dyspozycyjność przez cały dzień, ponieważ godziny mogą ulec zmianie.

📏 POSZUKIWANE WYMIARY:

• Rozmiar ogólny: L

• Wzrost: 182 cm

• Waga: 84 kg

• Obwód głowy: 59 cm

• Obwód szyi: 42 cm

• Obwód klatki piersiowej: 102 cm

• Obwód pasa: 98 cm

• Obwód bioder: 103 cm

• Marynarka: 52

• Jeansy: 32/32, preferowany rozmiar 33 w pasie

• Buty: 43–44

• Kołnierzyk: 41–42

🗣️ Wymagana umiejętność mówienia i rozumienia w języku polskim.

💰 Stawka: 250 zł netto, płatne przelewem.

Proszę o SMS pod numer 797 169 069 z dopiskiem „standin 07.10”.

• imię i nazwisko,

• wiek,

• wszystkie wymiary wymienione w ogłoszeniu,

• dołączyć wyraźne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki.

⏰ Na zgłoszenia czekam do niedzieli 04.10, do końca dnia.

Dobrego dnia!

Marta Filmakcja 😁🎬

• imię i nazwisko,

• wiek,

• wszystkie wymiary wymienione w ogłoszeniu,

• dołączyć wyraźne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki.

⏰ Na zgłoszenia czekam do niedzieli 04.10, do końca dnia.

Dobrego dnia!

Marta Filmakcja 😁🎬

CASTING CALL!!!
Hi there, we are making a documentary about a woman re-visiting her past trauma about being bullied because of her weight and reclaiming it.

In this documentary we need to do reenactments and are looking for a child actor around 7-11 who looks like her. I have added a photo of her below.

This is a student film with the University of Gloucestershire, with filming happening around the Cheltenham area. Unfortunately, because it is a student film, this is unpaid but food and drinks and travel will be paid for.

Filming will be taking place October- November.

If you are interested please email liamgarrattfilm@gmail.com.

Thank you.
